chunks: Al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh, who said:
I said to him: There is something that people say: that most of the people of the Fire on the Day of Resurrection are women.
He said: How can that be, when a man may marry, in the Hereafter, a thousand women from the women of this world in a palace made of a single pearl?
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام respond to the claim that most of the people of Hell are women?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a commonly repeated claim that most of the inhabitants of Hell are women and rejects it through a description of marriage in the Hereafter. It situates the discussion within eschatological realities and indicates abundance among the women of this world who enter the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4627 - Al-Fudayl narrated from Abu Abdullah (as).
I said to Imam (as): "There is something people say, that most of the inhabitants of Hell on the Day of Judgment will be women."
Imam (as) replied: "How can that be, when a man may marry a thousand women of this world in the Hereafter, all within a single palace made of one pearl?"
